_comment: Copy this file to email.config.json and fill in your credentials. email.config.json is gitignored.

smtp._comment_gmail: For Gmail: use smtp.gmail.com port 587, and generate an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (requires 2FA). Use the App Password, NOT your Gmail login password.
smtp._comment_outlook: For Outlook/Hotmail: host smtp-mail.outlook.com, port 587, secure false.
smtp._comment_custom: For corporate SMTP: ask your IT team for host/port/credentials.
